text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (gateway). Incident ID INC-2026-0453. Correlation root: corr=8e4f2b. Paging on-call: @ella_oncall :rotating_light:

ella_oncall: I’m on it. Noticed spike at 12:07:03 UTC. Rolling up some quick numbers — ~12% 5xx over last 3m, avg latency up from 180ms -> 620ms.

sam_m: Seen similar in metrics. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-2026-0453
- error type: gateway 502/504 + internal 503s
- top upstream: model-runtime-03 (us-west)

ella_oncall: Quick customer impact check: top 3 tenants with errors — corpA, buildly, analytics-inc. CorpA has ~3% of traffic but 55% of failures. Putting cust-escalations on notify.

cust-escalations: Acknowledged. Notifying CS lead + account owner for corpA. ETA for update to customer 30m.

mike_rt: Sharing log grep I ran: 
```
# grep corr=8e4f2b /var/log/gateway/2026-02-14.log | head -30
2026-02-14T12:07:04Z gateway INFO req=.. corr=8e4f2b upstream=model-runtime-03 GET /v1/generate 502 "upstream read timeout"
2026-02-14T12:07:05Z gateway INFO req=.. corr=8e4f2b upstream=model-runtime-03 POST /v1/generate 504 "upstream responded slowly"
2026-02-14T12:07:06Z gateway INFO req=.. corr=8e4f2b route=dedicated-pool fallback=queued retries=1
```
Hypothesis: upstream runtime experiencing a short QPS spike causing read timeouts, gateway retry ladder amplifying load.

irene: I pulled runtime metrics for model-runtime-03 — GPU utilization hit 99% at 12:06:58, concurrent requests jumped 3x. Memory usage stable. No obvious OOMs.

carla: Are we seeing retry amplification? Check gateway retries metric and egress rate.

sam_m: Yes, retries spiked from 0.2 -> 1.4 average per second for that route. Looks like clients get 502 -> retry -> hits slow runtime -> more 502s.

ella_oncall: Mitigation checklist (executing):
- [x] Disable gateway automatic retries for /v1/generate for 5m (to avoid amplification) — command: `kubectl patch cm gateway-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"retries":"0"}}'`
- [x] Scale up model-runtime-03 pool by +2 replicas (manual) — `k scale deploy model-runtime-03 --replicas=6 -n inference`
- [x] Add temporary route fallback to second-best model (model-runtime-04) for corpA — updating routing policy now.

opsbot: Action executed: gateway retries config updated (retries=0) — rollout id r-20260214-17.

opsbot: Action executed: k scale deploy model-runtime-03 -> replicas=6. New pods starting; 1/2 ready.

mike_rt: After turning off retries, 5xx rate dropped to ~4% in 90s. Latency trending down to 260ms. Good sign.

irene: New pods are ready. GPU utilization on model-runtime-03 back to 68%. No new 502s observed for requests routed explicitly to runtime-04 fallback.

sam_m: Capturing timeline for RCA notes:
- 12:06:50 UTC — QPS jump on /v1/generate from 1200 -> 3600 (traffic surge from client corpA batch job)
- 12:07:00 UTC — model-runtime-03 GPU saturation, increased queueing
- 12:07:03 UTC — gateway observed upstream timeouts -> automatic retries triggered (default 1)
- 12:07:04-12:07:10 UTC — retry loop amplifies load -> further timeouts -> higher 5xx rate
- 12:07:12 UTC — oncall disables retries and scales pool -> metrics recover

ella_oncall: Hypotheses to track in RCA: 
1) Traffic surge from corpA batch caused transient saturation on model-runtime-03 (primary).
2) Gateway automatic retries (and client retries) amplified load and pushed runtime into overload.
3) Autoscaler did not react quickly due to our scale-up policy thresholds (policy uses 30s window).

carla: For RCA evidence, we need:
- correlationIDs bundle (I’ll upload to logdropbox)
- ingress/gateway config at time of incident (pre-change)
- runtime pod metrics and HPA events
- customer request pattern from corpA (they claim it was a scheduled job)

ella_oncall: I’m uploading KV log bundle now: link https://dropbox.internal/logs/INC-2026-0453/corr-8e4f2b.tar.gz (contains gateway traces + runtime logs + metrics snippets).

mike_rt: Pasted a couple of representative request traces showing retry ladder: 
```
trace-id: t-7a9b
12:06:59 gateway -> model-runtime-03 POST /v1/generate 502
12:07:00 client retry -> gateway POST /v1/generate
12:07:00 gateway -> model-runtime-03 POST /v1/generate 504
```
This shows client-side retry coming in within 1s.

irene: Note: HPA event shows scale-up requested at 12:07:05 but pods didn't become ready until 12:07:22 due to model load boot time (~15s). Need to include in RCA.

sam_m: Immediate postmortem tasks assigned:
- sam_m: collect and attach gateway config / logs (done)
- carla: assemble corrid log bundle and link (uploading)
- irene: HPA & pod readiness timeline and autoscaler thresholds (doing)
- mike_rt: customer traffic pattern & corpA contact (on it)

ella_oncall: Handing off to @sam_m for long-form RCA — I’ll remain reachable for follow-ups. Next on-call is @mike_rt at 12:40 UTC; paging schedule updated.

sam_m: I’ll own RCA. Drafting timeline and hypothesis doc, will link to postmortem ticket P-2026-311.

cust-escalations: Customer update: corpA notified, they confirmed a misconfigured cron re-run at 12:05 UTC. We offered a post-incident summary and mitigation steps.

carla: Upload complete: https://dropbox.internal/logs/INC-2026-0453/bundle.tar.gz (contains corrIDs, gateway configs, runtime logs, HPA events).

ella_oncall: Closing incident channel for live mitigation — incident status: mitigated, severity: Sev2 (customer impact but recovered quickly). Keep thread open for RCA coordination. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> status: recovered. RCA owner: sam_m. Follow-up ticket: P-2026-311.

sam_m: Thanks team — I’ll summarize root cause and proposed actions:
- Root causes: bursty scheduled customer job + gateway retries amplifying load + slow scale-up due to model boot time.
- Immediate action items: reduce gateway retry default for latency-sensitive routes; add retry budget; adjust HPA thresholds and warm pool for high-traffic tenants; run client education for corpA; improve customer-facing rate-limiting doc.

mike_rt: Adding ops runbook update: add explicit steps to temporarily disable retries and add fallback routing. Will PR to repo infra/playbooks.

irene: Also recommending: warm start for models (preload weights) on scale-up path to reduce readiness time.

ella_oncall: Thanks everyone. I’ll leave final notes in the postmortem ticket and assign owners.
